pkg/authz.Engine: versioned, signed, approved policy Documents with Rule/Condition-based RBAC+ABAC evaluation (Can/DryRun/Explanation), relationship-based (ReBAC) checks via Relate/hasRelation.
pkg/insurance/caseroom.Authorize/AuthorizeContext: tenant, jurisdiction, and scope matching, fail-closed on any mismatch, chained into the Golden Cross-Domain Case.
Cross-tenant and cross-jurisdiction access are both explicitly adversarially tested against the real golden case, not a synthetic fixture.
Delegation chain depth is policy-limited (default 5) and enforced at registration time; self-delegation and over-depth chains are refused.
Both revoked and expired relationships are proven unable to act, against the real golden case.

Idempotency-key replay is explicitly tested (same key/same payload replays the stored result; same key/different payload is a conflict; concurrent in-flight use is refused, not double-executed); cold replay of the whole golden case (including Case Room authorization) is proven identical to the live run.
Tampered evidence artifacts are refused rather than degrading silently; tampered release-certificate signatures are detected; tampered axis evidence degrades to FAIL rather than passing.
Malformed JWTs are refused at the verifier; broader malformed-input handling is exercised across the acceptance adversarial suite.

pkg/blockers/pentest.probeCommandInjectionViaSandbox (Round 8, new): a battery of classic shell-injection payloads (command chaining, substitution, pipes to a listener, embedded newlines) submitted as PROCESS_SPAWN targets against the real sandbox enforcer, confirming none bypasses the fail-closed AllowProcessSpawn=false default. Combined with the pre-existing probePathTraversal, this codebase's own zero-SQL, zero-external-dependency architecture now has adversarial coverage across both injection surfaces it actually has (file paths, process spawning).

pkg/connector/ssrfguard (Round 8, new): a real, reusable SSRF guard (scheme allow-listing plus loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata/private-range/unspecified/multicast address blocking), wired into pkg/connector/aisstream's own Config.validate (the one connector in this repository that accepts a caller-supplied URL). pkg/blockers/pentest.probeSSRFGuardRejectsKnownPayloads exercises it against real SSRF payload shapes (169.254.169.254 cloud metadata, loopback, RFC1918 ranges, gopher:// smuggling). 15 network-free unit tests in ssrfguard's own suite plus 5 adversarial config cases in aisstream's suite.

Token-bucket rate limiting with per-tenant/actor/endpoint isolation, per-endpoint rule overrides, and deterministic behavior; the Gateway itself is proven to reject BEFORE consuming rate budget (so a rejected request cannot itself be used to exhaust the budget) and returns 429 correctly.
Token issuer/audience/expiry/not-before are all enforced; a tampered payload fails signature verification even with an otherwise well-formed token.

internal/timestamp provides a hash-chained, tamper-evident notary chain for release certificates; pkg/platform/audit exists and is used by cmd/veriqo-node/cmd/veriqo-gateway/pkg/workflow.
